_comment: F1 seam events. The ONLY hand-curated data file; every entry carries its source. Dates are the month the change takes effect. 'applies_to' matches catalog dataset short_name prefixes or AppEEARS product prefixes. Entries marked verify=true were cited from the team's research (docs/05-novelty-features.md) with only abstract/metadata seen.

events.description: IMERG calibration changes from the TRMM era to the GPM era; trend agreement with gauges drops from 86.7% (GPM era) to 75.3% (TRMM era).
events.citation: Zhu et al., Environ. Res. Lett. 20:014064

events.description: SSM/I radiances enter the MERRA-2 observing system; reported to introduce unphysical precipitation/moisture changes.
AMSU radiances enter the MERRA-2 observing system; a known source of discontinuities in moisture-related fields.
Terra begins orbital drift (earlier overpass time), which can bias MODIS Terra land products such as LST and vegetation indices.
events.citation: NASA NTRS 20240001409; Science of Remote Sensing 2023

events.description: Terra exits its constellation orbit; overpass-time drift continues.
Cloud Giovanni inserted spurious blocks of zeros in some hydrology/reanalysis collections for data before 2024; fixed 2026-03-26. Series retrieved before the fix must be re-fetched.
